summary: Let continuously active OMP seats receive mailbox handoffs without an initial idle edge

rules.detail: OMP emits delivery_ready after a validated hello and native-session binding, independently of idle; interrupted-ask restoration retains its fence. Stale delivery reasons include elapsed non-ready seconds.

compatibility.detail: Uses the existing delivery_ready frame; older channels already accept it and older extensions retain their initial idle gate.

manual.detail: No configuration changes; existing sessions need the updated extension loaded to emit the proof.

recovery.detail: Pending mail remains in its existing mailbox until the handoff path proves ready.
